current_question: Can an ordinary product workflow make the relationship between current activity and release state understandable without naming an evaluator, score, record path, editing method or desired action?
current_gap: R206 made the current-activity object visible and all four owners used it, but they inferred a peer-approval workflow and made zero native-record changes.

next_condition.mechanism: One natural product-level relationship between the read-only activity preview and release state.
next_condition.constraint: Do not restore a score, evaluator, scheduled reviewer, record path, edit instruction, fabricated peer message, repeated instruction or multi-owner transaction interface.

latest_reviewed_rollout.interpretation: Capability-exposure positive and terminal-outcome negative: all four owners found the ordinary preview and coordinated peer reconciliation, but none changed the current native record and every publication attempt remained blocked.
